sources.source_role: verify_manifest:164 validates the declared bundle; _closure:118 walks reachable includes.
sources.required_inputs: Manifest fields and file records are explicit; _relative:59 rejects missing/escaping files, _file_manifest:76 hashes every record, _closure rejects unlisted includes, source identity is bound at :173-176.
sources.optional_outputs: OUTPUTS declares future destinations; verify_manifest does not require output files to exist.
sources.consumer: The model probe consumes verify_manifest; the native harness also binds manifest bytes before and after each phase.
sources.child_success: Not applicable: an input validator, no child success flag.
sources.cleanup_request: Not applicable: no owned process or termination request.
sources.cleanup_observation: Not applicable: pure file validation does not observe process cleanup.
sources.test_execution: Inspected only; no model-manifest tests executed in this slice.
limitations: Expected records originate in the supplied manifest; no independent census of all source files is inferred.
Resolved case-folded paths at :85 are identities, not inode comparisons; input/output hard links are outside this check.
Explicit hash seed at :150 is a reproducibility condition, not native settings readback.

sources.source_role: validate_report:42 is a parent-side proof consumer; validate_results:16 checks retained arrays.
sources.required_inputs: Phase, completion, true verification flags, one-thread evidence, exact manifest digest, hash syntax, version, warnings and finite result arrays are required.
sources.optional_outputs: No output files are enumerated or opened by this module; the caller binds retained bytes.
sources.consumer: The native harness model_phase:242 invokes validate_report and separately hashes loaded exports and saved simulation.
sources.child_success: ok alone is insufficient: :43-60 requires completion and results; :61-67 compares exact solve/readback arrays.
sources.cleanup_request: Not applicable: the validator does not own or terminate a process.
sources.cleanup_observation: Not applicable: process cleanup must be observed by the caller before accepting the report.
sources.test_execution: Executed offline: nine missing-field cases and one complete/exact-readback case passed at the base.
limitations: Flags and digest syntax are content checks, not authentication of native settings observations or artifact bytes.
Time grid :19-20 assumes the reviewed fixed sample count and seconds grid; :36 requires nonempty units/frames without validating their meaning.

sources.source_role: Native parent harness: run_model:273 and run_smoke:300 declare sources and bind retained proof.
sources.required_inputs: hashes:220-222 filters files, but run_model:274-276 and run_smoke:304-305 reject missing mandatory sources before hashing/launch. Read failures propagate. model_sources:233-240 includes six mandatory paths plus two present optional helpers.
sources.optional_outputs: main:343 enumerates scratch files for diagnostic hashes, not required-input coverage. Optional model_results.py/model_contract.py inclusion is presence-based; no broader required-file policy is established here.
sources.consumer: run_model rechecks source/manifest bytes around both phases; model_phase compares stdout/results, validates arrays and checks actual loaded-export/simulation hashes.
sources.child_success: main begins ok=False; sets true only after the parent path returns; exceptions retain error type/stage and a diagnostic log with exit failure.
sources.cleanup_request: drain_owned:143 requests job termination and, when needed, root termination; kill-on-close is a fallback request.
sources.cleanup_observation: drain_owned:143-162 queries active job members and observes successful root waits within a deadline. cleanup_owned:160-187 rethrows uncertainty and closes handles in nested finally blocks; return from run_owned includes cleanup completion.
sources.test_execution: Inspected only: Windows harness/cleanup tests were not executed; no PowerShell worker or native process was started.
limitations: Optional-source policy remains a review question; a filtering helper alone does not establish a missing-input defect.
cleanup_owned:170-171 suppresses a fallback termination error while preserving the original cleanup failure; no success is returned on that path.
Smoke :209 converts numeric proof with float and uses kN labels; model-phase byte checks do not authenticate a physical measurement.
The 10-second drain deadline, millisecond conversion and sample/file-size thresholds are existing operational assumptions, not new acceptance criteria.

sources.source_role: Checked Windows ABI primitives, including wait:142-145 and close:90-91.
sources.required_inputs: Process/job handles are supplied by the caller. No file-input declaration or hash manifest is emitted.
sources.optional_outputs: Not applicable: ABI helper emits no retained solver files.
sources.consumer: _owned_process.cleanup:100 checks false waits and API failures, aggregates uncertainty and attempts every handle release; this is caller context, not an additional assessed source row.
sources.child_success: Not applicable: wait returns observed signaled state, not a solver verdict.
sources.cleanup_request: JOB_KILL_ON_CLOSE:12 configures a termination request; close checks the API result.
sources.cleanup_observation: wait:142-145 returns true only for signaled status, false for timeout, raises for other results. A successful wait alone does not establish whole-job drain or handle release.
sources.test_execution: Inspected only; this ABI module and its tests were not imported or executed.
limitations: Default wait timeout :142 is zero milliseconds, a poll; callers must distinguish false from successful cleanup.
Platform sizing fallback :112 uses the expected sizing error on non-Windows mocks; native behavior remains NOT_EVALUATED.

sources.source_role: write_input_manifest:181 fingerprints explicit seeds plus YAML composition closure; verify_input_manifest:201 recomputes the bundle.
sources.required_inputs: _input_path:55 rejects missing/escaping dependencies; _capture:119 requires seeds, reads bytes or raises, discovers repeated includes and BaseFile references, detects cycles and records exact path/digest pairs.
sources.optional_outputs: The manifest is the output, excluded from its own inputs. Opaque dependency graphs and unresolved external references give NOT_EVALUATED rather than complete coverage.
sources.consumer: verify_input_manifest compares file-set union, aggregate and metadata fingerprints plus full recomputed evidence; callers inspect revision status separately.
sources.child_success: Not applicable: offline fingerprints do not execute a solver or accept child success.
sources.cleanup_request: Not applicable: no owned native process.
sources.cleanup_observation: Not applicable: local file hashing does not observe process lifecycle.
sources.test_execution: Inspected only; generator and manifest tests were not executed.
limitations: Seed completeness is the caller's obligation (:184); recomputation cannot discover an omitted unreferenced seed independently.
Revisions remain NOT_EVALUATED (:171-176); integrity is not solver attestation.
Traversal continues at :88, :139, :144 and :152 skip empty/seen nodes, graph exits, already-hashed paths and opaque parsing respectively; unresolved coverage remains explicit.
verify_input_manifest:251-258 converts read/parse errors into FAIL findings, not an empty success record.
